Constellation Energy (CEG) stock lost 20.4% over the past twelve months, dividends included, while the S&P 500 gained 11.7%. On its November 9, 2026 call, management said it does not think the market has given the business its full value, and that it intends to address that in how it allocates capital by the time of its fiscal Q4 2026 report. Below are the events most likely to move Constellation Energy stock in the months ahead.

Constellation Energy is expected to report fiscal Q4 2026 results in February 2027, and management said it will update its 2027 and 2028 guidance on that call, along with a refreshed growth outlook through 2030 . That guide follows repeated raises to the 2026 outlook. Management now expects 2026 adjusted operating earnings of $12.50 to $12.80 per share, and the low end of that range equals the top of its previous one. So far in 2026, Constellation has also signed long-term nuclear agreements that run well into the 2040s, including landmark deals with Google and Amazon. The measure to watch is the 2027 adjusted operating earnings per share guide, in February 2027.

Constellation Energy’s Next Buyback Plan

Management said investors should expect an updated buyback plan on or before the fiscal Q4 2026 call in February 2027, in line with its usual practice. The company has been buying steadily. It repurchased about $3 billion of its stock in roughly seven months after its March business update, and it expects to finish its current authorization by the end of 2027. The measure to watch is the size of that updated buyback plan, due by February 2027.

Management expects FERC to act on colocation in the first half of 2027. Colocation means placing large power users, such as data centers, right at Constellation’s own plants, and management argues it is the most cost-effective way to bring that kind of demand onto the grid. The ruling matters because Constellation still has more than 100 million megawatt-hours of existing clean generation that management says is available for premium long-term agreements, and colocation is one route for selling that power. A decision could widen that route or narrow it. Management is not waiting on regulators, though. It says a delay in the PJM backstop auction gave it time to complete agreements directly with customers. The measure to watch is the FERC colocation decision, expected in the first half of 2027.

Can You Hold Constellation Energy Through These Dates?

Constellation Energy stock has already shown how far it can fall in a short stretch . From its high close on December 11, 2025, the stock fell 37.5% by July 1, 2026. The worst single day in that slide came on March 20, 2026, when the shares lost 10.9%. If another fall of that size would force you to sell, your position may be too large to hold through these dates.

chineseTitle: 星座能源股票很快会发生什么？
chineseSummary: 如果对本文或基础研究有疑问，请发送电子邮件至 help@trefis.com。
chineseContent:
如果对本文或基础研究有疑问，请发送电子邮件至 help@trefis.com。

Constellation Energy (CEG) 股票在过去 12 个月内下跌了 20.4%（包括股息），而标准普尔 500 指数则上涨了 11.7%。在 2026 年 11 月 9 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，它认为市场并未赋予该业务全部价值，并打算在 2026 年第四季度财报发布之前解决资本分配问题。以下是未来几个月最有可能影响星座能源股票的事件。

Constellation Energy 预计将于 2027 年 2 月公布 2026 年第四季度财报，管理层表示将根据该电话会议更新其 2027 年和 2028 年指引，以及更新后的 2030 年增长前景。该指南是在多次上调 2026 年前景之后发布的。管理层目前预计 2026 年调整后运营收益为每股 12.50 美元至 12.80 美元，该区间的下限与上一区间的上限相同。截至 2026 年，Constellation 还签署了持续到 2040 年代的长期核协议，其中包括与谷歌和亚马逊的里程碑式协议。值得关注的指标是 2027 年 2 月发布的 2027 年调整后每股营业收益指南。

Constellation Energy的下一步回购计划

管理层表示，按照惯例，投资者应该预计会在 2027 年 2 月召开的 2026 年第四季度财报电话会议之前或之前看到更新的回购计划。该公司一直在稳步采购。在 3 月份的业务更新后大约七个月内，该公司回购了约 30 亿美元的股票，预计将在 2027 年底前完成当前的授权。值得关注的指标是更新后的回购计划的规模，该计划将于 2027 年 2 月到期。

管理层预计 FERC 将在 2027 年上半年就主机托管采取行动。主机托管意味着将数据中心等大型电力用户放置在 Constellation 自己的工厂内，管理层认为这是将此类需求引入电网的最具成本效益的方式。这项裁决很重要，因为 Constellation 仍拥有超过 1 亿兆瓦时的现有清洁发电量，管理层称这些发电量可用于签订优质长期协议，而托管是出售这些电力的一种途径。一项决定可能会拓宽或缩小这条路线。不过，管理层并没有等待监管机构。该公司表示，PJM 后挡板拍卖的延迟使其有时间直接与客户完成协议。值得关注的措施是 FERC 的主机托管决定，预计将于 2027 年上半年做出。

你能在这些日子里保持星座能量吗？

星座能源公司的股票已经显示出它可以在短时间内下跌多少。从2025年12月11日的高收盘价到2026年7月1日，该股下跌了37.5%。该股跌势最糟糕的一天发生在2026年3月20日，当时该股下跌了10.9%。如果再次出现同样规模的下跌将迫使您卖出，您的头寸可能太大而无法在这些日期内持有。

下跌后仍持有星座能量？
